author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: तदेवेत्युक्तं रूपमाह ॥ किरीटिनमिति । यथा विश्वरूपं दृष्टवानस्मि तथैव तेनैव पूर्वदृष्टेन चतुर्भुजेन रूपेण त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छामि । हे सहस्रबाहो अनन्तबाहो विश्वमूर्ते गुणपूर्णविग्रहेति वा विश्वस्मिन्मूर्तिर्यस्येति वाऽर्थः ॥ ११.४६॥
translation:
Thee wearing diadem with Gada and discus in the hand, I wish to see as before; pray, Thou be in the same form with four arms, thousand-armed, O Perfect One, to whom everything is like unto a body. (46) 
A. To intensify devotion Sri Krishna states that it is not the lot of everybody, or even of many, to gain this vision of the Lord's glorious self.
